scope: All current architecture content-copy classes plus planned protected fields. References locate present code, not an implementation of RFC-0019. External retention cannot be certified by engine tests.

layouts.duckdb_directory: memory.duckdb plus vectors.usearch and lexical_index/. Fernet .enc files decrypt on open.
layouts.duckdb_single_file: One .prme DuckDB with vector_snapshot; lexical index in RAM; optional native encryption including WAL and enabled encrypted spill.
layouts.postgresql: events/nodes/edges/operations plus pgvector, generated tsvector and lexical_documents. Physical WAL, replicas and backups are deployment-owned.

principals.operator: Trusted local Python/CLI process and file/database administrator; unbound low-level access is not an authenticated tenant boundary.
principals.ordinary: Owner/scope-authorized application client; HTTP/MCP may use configured bound identity or trusted operator mode.
principals.ingress: Receiving process, caller and configured pre-engine middleware.
principals.worker: Ingestion/organizer/recovery process; future protected access limited by purpose and active work claim.
principals.diagnostic: Explicit scoped finite evidence-read capability plus audit/key permission, proposed by RFC-0019.
principals.client: Response recipient, framework, browser, downstream answer/tool consumer.
principals.hosted: Consuming service operator of ingress, IAM, independent ledger, logs and backups.

retention_policies.source: Encrypted sanitized evidence until explicit evidence deadline or erasure, whichever first; never original input. No-evidence retains none.
retention_policies.memory: Sanitized admitted memory until own erase-after deadline or explicit erasure; archive is not erase.
retention_policies.processing: Encrypted sanitized pending input until earliest success/cancel/erase/source deadline/configured work deadline; proposed ceiling 24h.
retention_policies.journal: Executable admitted-memory inputs only; source attachments use protected references and source expiry. Erasure removes affected snapshots/derivatives; content-free identity may remain.
retention_policies.query: Persist only sanitized/minimized query or protected attachment with explicit finite policy; redact/erase predictable-text hashes and affected query/execution copies.
retention_policies.transient: No durable PRME copy; drop references after request/work; no heap-zeroization or recipient revocation guarantee.
retention_policies.metadata: Opaque validated bounded metadata only; access scoped and retention explicit. Content-bearing keys/values inherit source/memory policy.
retention_policies.artifact: Same effective content deadlines as represented records; enforce current independent erasure ledger on restore before serving. No physical-wipe claim.
retention_policies.external: Actual holder controls retention; report the boundary and remaining copies. Do not claim remote erasure without holder evidence.
retention_policies.rejected_visual: Reject protected visual admission before provider/storage; legacy blobs/descriptions require explicit migration refusal or removal.
retention_policies.provider_key: Separate purpose keys outside pack; finite unlock, explicit rotation/recovery/disposal. Live deletion is not backup deletion.

erasure_owners.engine: PV-06 engine privacy purge covers managed logical copies and resumable derivative traversal; PV-05/PV-07 cooperate. Not implemented at inventory revision.
erasure_owners.application: Application operator prevents raw middleware/log/cache copies and coordinates clients/providers.
erasure_owners.storage_operator: Filesystem/database/backup operator owns WAL retention, physical residue, replicas, snapshots and unmanaged copies.
erasure_owners.key_provider: Local or hosted key custodian owns purpose/epoch key state and recovery copies.
erasure_owners.recipient: Recipient owns already delivered/copied text; engine cannot revoke it.
erasure_owners.hosted_service: Hosted epic owns independent ledger, IAM, diagnostic browser/session lifecycle and managed cloud snapshots.
